RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve the claims arising out of [identify the dispute or action] (the “Dispute”), on the terms below.

1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff [amount and currency] (the “Settlement Amount”) within [number] business days after this Agreement has been signed by both parties and Plaintiff has provided written payment instructions. Payment shall be made by wire transfer of immediately available funds to the account designated by Plaintiff.

2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount in full in immediately available funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from all claims arising out of the Dispute based on acts or omissions occurring on or before the date this Agreement is signed by both parties. This release does not extend to claims to enforce this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except for disclosures to their legal, tax, and financial advisers who are bound by confidentiality obligations, disclosures reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement, and disclosures required by law, regulation, or court order. Where legally permitted, a party receiving a compulsory disclosure request shall give the other party prompt notice and reasonably cooperate in seeking confidential treatment. Nothing in this Agreement prohibits lawful reporting to, or cooperation with, a governmental or regulatory authority or requires advance notice of such reporting or cooperation.

drafter.private_reasoning: No authorized settlement amount or payment date has been provided. Leave those commercial terms expressly open for client instructions rather than inventing an offer. Replace the floating payment deadline with a fixed-date requirement, preserve enforcement rights, and require approval before execution without a post-signature approval contingency. Do not disclose unrelated confidential client information.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: We have revised the payment provision to require a fixed calendar deadline and retained the cleared-funds condition to the release and the express reservation of enforcement rights. We have also added confirmation that client approval must precede execution, with no approval contingency surviving signature. The proposed amount and specific payment date remain subject to client instructions; the bracketed fields must be completed before execution. We will revert with those commercial terms once authorized.

Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount in full in cleared, immediately available funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from all claims arising out of the Dispute based on acts or omissions occurring on or before the date this Agreement is signed by both parties. edits.text:
4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability.

5. APPROVAL AND EXECUTION. Each party shall obtain all necessary client and other internal approvals before signing this Agreement. Each person signing represents that such approvals have been obtained and that the person has authority to bind the party on whose behalf the person signs. Upon execution by both parties, this Agreement is binding and is not subject to any further client or internal approval contingency.
